quests.instruction: A child is going outside. It is raining and windy. Which choice would help keep the child dry and comfortable?
quests.correctAnswer: A zip-up waterproof jacket with a hood 🧥
options: A zip-up waterproof jacket with a hood 🧥
A wide straw hat and sandals 👒
A cotton cardigan and an open umbrella ☂️
quests.hint: Wind and rain both matter here.
quests.explanation: A zip-up, hooded jacket keeps rain off and stays on in wind. Umbrellas can flip, and cotton or straw soak up water.
quests.funFact: Strong gusts can turn an umbrella inside out.

quests.instruction: The sun is out, but the air is cold and a strong wind is blowing. What should Mei wear for her walk?
quests.correctAnswer: Windproof jacket and a hat that covers her ears 🧢
options: T-shirt and a wide sun hat 👕
Windproof jacket and a hat that covers her ears 🧢
Rain poncho and open sandals 🌧️
quests.explanation: Wind makes cold air feel even colder, so a windproof layer and covered ears keep her comfortable.
quests.funFact: Wind carries heat away from skin faster than still air.

quests.instruction: It is hot and humid, and showers may pop up in the afternoon. Which choice makes the most sense?
quests.correctAnswer: Light quick-drying clothes and a packable rain jacket 🎒
options: Light quick-drying clothes and a packable rain jacket 🎒
Thick jeans, a sweater, and a scarf 🧶
A winter coat and wool socks ❄️
quests.hint: Plan for heat and a short rain.
quests.explanation: Light clothes keep him cool, and a packable jacket is there if the rain arrives.
quests.funFact: Humid air makes sweat slower to dry, so breathable clothes feel better.

quests.instruction: It is chilly, and Kai will be playing a fast game of tag for an hour. Which choice is best?
quests.correctAnswer: Light layers he can take off 🧥
options: A raincoat and rain boots 🌧️
One very thick winter coat ❄️
Light layers he can take off 🧥
quests.hint: Remember how running changes body heat.
quests.explanation: Running warms the body, so layers he can remove help him stay comfortable and not too sweaty.
quests.funFact: Taking off a layer before you overheat is easier than cooling down once sweaty.

quests.instruction: It is just as chilly, and Aisha will be sitting still for an hour watching a game. Which choice is best?
quests.correctAnswer: Warm coat, hat, and thick socks 🧣
options: A light T-shirt and shorts 👕
Warm coat, hat, and thick socks 🧣
A thin shirt and open sandals 🩴
quests.explanation: Without moving, your body makes less heat, so you need more insulation.
quests.funFact: Fidgeting and wiggling toes can help a little, but warm clothes work best.

quests.instruction: Kai and Aisha are in the same cold park. Why do they need different clothes?
quests.correctAnswer: Moving makes your body warmer than sitting still 🔥
options: Aisha is older and feels colder 🎂
Kai's shoes are warmer than hers 👟
Moving makes your body warmer than sitting still 🔥
quests.explanation: Exercise produces heat, so active people need less insulation than people who stay still.
quests.funFact: Muscles produce heat when they work.

quests.instruction: A day trip begins at 7 a.m. when it is chilly and ends at 3 p.m. when it will be warm. Which plan works best?
quests.correctAnswer: T-shirt, a light sweater, and a jacket she can pack away 🎒
options: Only a T-shirt and shorts 🩳
T-shirt, a light sweater, and a jacket she can pack away 🎒
A thick wool coat and a scarf 🧣
quests.hint: The temperature changes a lot during the day.
quests.explanation: Layers that can be added or removed fit both cool mornings and warm afternoons.
quests.funFact: Temperature often changes by ten degrees or more between morning and afternoon.

quests.instruction: The forecast says it will be dry in the morning, but rain is likely after lunch. Leo will be outside all day. What should he carry?
quests.correctAnswer: A packable rain jacket 🌧️
options: A packable rain jacket 🌧️
Swim goggles 🥽
Heavy winter boots 🥾
quests.hint: Plan for what may happen later.
quests.explanation: Having a light rain jacket in his bag keeps him dry if the rain begins.
quests.funFact: Packable jackets fold into their own pocket.

quests.instruction: It was a warm day, but a family will stay for fireworks after dark and the temperature is falling. What is wise?
quests.correctAnswer: Bring a warm jacket even though the day is warm 🧥
options: Bring sandals so feet stay cool 🩴
Wear only the light clothes from the afternoon 👕
Bring a warm jacket even though the day is warm 🧥
quests.hint: Think about the evening, not the afternoon.
quests.explanation: Temperatures often drop quickly after sunset, so a warm layer will be welcome later.
quests.funFact: Clear nights cool down faster than cloudy ones.

quests.instruction: Zoe waits at a cold bus stop, then rides a hot, crowded bus. Which approach to clothes works best?
quests.correctAnswer: Layers she can open or take off on the bus 🧥
options: Only a T-shirt 👕
Layers she can open or take off on the bus 🧥
One very thick sweater with no layer under it 🧶
quests.explanation: Layers let her stay warm outside and cool down inside.
quests.funFact: Many people get sweaty on buses when they wear too much.

quests.instruction: It is raining on the way to school. How can Noor keep her feet comfortable in class?
quests.correctAnswer: Wear rain boots and bring shoes to change into 🥾
options: Keep wearing the wet boots in class 😣
Take off the boots and wear damp socks 🧦
Wear rain boots and bring shoes to change into 🥾
quests.hint: Think about the walk and the classroom.
quests.explanation: Rain boots keep her feet dry outside. Changing into dry shoes helps her feel comfortable inside.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a place to keep outdoor shoes.

quests.instruction: Tariq's scarf gets damp from his breath on a freezing walk. What is a good idea?
quests.correctAnswer: Switch to a dry scarf if he has one 🧣
options: Wrap it tighter and keep it wet 💧
Switch to a dry scarf if he has one 🧣
Take off his coat 🧥
quests.explanation: Breath makes the fabric damp, and damp scarves chill the skin. A dry one feels warmer.
quests.funFact: Warm breath freezes into little ice crystals on a scarf in very cold air.

quests.instruction: It is a hot day at the splash park. Which choice makes the most sense for Priya?
quests.correctAnswer: Swimsuit, sunscreen, and water shoes 🏊
options: Jeans, a sweater, and wool socks 🧶
Swimsuit, sunscreen, and water shoes 🏊
Raincoat, rain boots, and a scarf 🌧️
quests.hint: Think about heat and getting wet.
quests.explanation: A swimsuit is made for water, sunscreen protects skin, and water shoes protect feet on hot, wet ground.
quests.funFact: Water play areas often have rough, hot concrete.

quests.instruction: The ground at the splash park is hot and slippery. Which footwear helps most?
quests.correctAnswer: Water shoes with grip 🩴
options: Water shoes with grip 🩴
Bare feet on the wet ground 🦶
Dress shoes with leather soles 👞
quests.hint: Hot and slippery are both clues.
quests.explanation: Water shoes cover and protect the feet and grip wet ground so you slip less.
quests.funFact: Wet surfaces get very slippery.

quests.instruction: Mei's cotton T-shirt is soaked and heavy after playing in the water. What would be a better choice next time?
quests.correctAnswer: A quick-dry shirt 👕
options: A quick-dry shirt 👕
A woolen sweater 🧶
A thick cotton hoodie 🧥
quests.explanation: Quick-dry fabrics let go of water quickly, so you feel lighter and don't get chilly.
quests.funFact: Synthetic fibers like nylon absorb little water.

quests.instruction: Wind makes a cold day feel even colder. Which choice helps most?
quests.correctAnswer: A windproof outer layer 🌬️
options: A thin scarf only 🧣
A windproof outer layer 🌬️
A loose cotton shirt 👕
quests.explanation: A windproof layer stops cold air from blowing through, so your body heat stays in.
quests.funFact: Wind chill describes how much colder the air feels when it is windy.

quests.instruction: Why can a knitted wool sweater feel warm in still air but chilly in strong wind?
quests.correctAnswer: Wind blows through the loops of the knit 🌬️
options: Wind blows through the loops of the knit 🌬️
Wool shrinks as soon as wind touches it 📉
Wind makes the wool sweater feel wet 💧
quests.explanation: Knitted loops have small gaps. In wind, air passes through them, so a windproof layer on top helps.
quests.funFact: Tightly woven fabrics block wind better than loose knits.

quests.instruction: Gusts keep lifting Lina's skirt on the playground. What could she wear underneath?
quests.correctAnswer: Shorts or leggings 🩳
options: A heavier coat 🧥
A longer scarf 🧣
Shorts or leggings 🩳
quests.hint: She wants to feel covered and free to play.
quests.explanation: Shorts or leggings under a skirt keep her comfortable when the wind lifts it.
quests.funFact: Skirts and dresses are easy to wear for play with the right layer underneath.

quests.instruction: Diego will hike for two hours on a sunny, hot trail with little shade. Which plan is smartest?
quests.correctAnswer: Light long sleeves, hat, sturdy shoes, and water 💧
options: Light long sleeves, hat, sturdy shoes, and water 💧
Cotton hoodie, canvas slip-ons, and no hat 👟
Tank top, flip-flops, and a small towel 🩴
quests.hint: Think sun, heat, and uneven ground.
quests.explanation: Light sleeves and a hat protect from the sun, sturdy shoes protect feet, and water keeps him hydrated.
quests.funFact: Hikers drink small amounts of water often.

quests.instruction: A trail is muddy after rain. Which footwear helps Ravi most?
quests.correctAnswer: Boots with a grippy sole 🥾
options: Boots with a grippy sole 🥾
Smooth-soled dress shoes 👞
Slip-on slippers 🥿
quests.explanation: Boots with deep treads grip mud and keep water and dirt off the feet.
quests.funFact: The grooves on soles are designed to push mud away.

quests.instruction: Why do many hikers wear quick-drying socks instead of thick cotton ones?
quests.correctAnswer: Wet cotton stays damp and can cause blisters 🧦
options: Cotton socks are harder to take off 🧦
Wet cotton stays damp and can cause blisters 🧦
Quick-dry socks make boots feel looser 🥾
quests.explanation: Cotton holds water. Damp socks rub more and make feet cold.
quests.funFact: Hikers often pack a spare pair of socks.

quests.instruction: Ravi is walking home at dusk in light rain. Which raincoat makes him easiest for drivers to see?
quests.correctAnswer: A bright coat with reflective strips ✨
options: A dark green coat with big pockets 🌑
A plain grey poncho that blends in 🌫️
A bright coat with reflective strips ✨
quests.hint: Drivers look for light and brightness.
quests.explanation: Bright color and reflective strips help car lights find you in the rain and the dusk.
quests.funFact: Rain and dusk reduce how far drivers can see.

quests.instruction: A family goes camping, and the night will be much colder than the day. What should Sana wear to sleep?
quests.correctAnswer: Warm base layer, dry socks, and a hat 🧦
options: Her damp daytime clothes and wet socks 💧
Only a thin T-shirt and shorts 👕
Warm base layer, dry socks, and a hat 🧦
quests.explanation: A dry base layer, socks, and a hat hold body heat in during a cold night.
quests.funFact: Sleeping bags work best when you are dry.

quests.instruction: It's dark and cold, and Kai bikes to a friend's house. Which combination suits the ride?
quests.correctAnswer: Warm jacket with reflective strips, gloves, and a helmet 🚲
options: Dark hoodie, thin gloves, and no helmet 🌑
Warm jacket with reflective strips, gloves, and a helmet 🚲
Shorts, sandals, and a bright T-shirt 🩴
quests.explanation: Warmth, visibility, and head protection address cold, darkness, and falls.
quests.funFact: Lights on the bike also help drivers see you.

quests.instruction: After a long game in the sun, Zoe feels dizzy and her face is red. What should she do?
quests.correctAnswer: Go to shade, loosen layers, and drink water 💧
options: Put on a coat and sit in the sun 🧥
Keep playing until the game ends 🏃
Go to shade, loosen layers, and drink water 💧
quests.explanation: Shade, water, and fewer layers help her cool down. If she feels very unwell, she should tell an adult.
quests.funFact: Hot weather can make the body struggle to cool itself.

quests.instruction: Omar's toes feel numb in snow boots. What should he do?
quests.correctAnswer: Go inside and warm his feet 🏠
options: Go inside and warm his feet 🏠
Run faster 🏃
Take his boots off outside ❄️
quests.hint: Numb toes are a warning sign.
quests.explanation: Numbness means toes are too cold. Going inside warms them gently.
quests.funFact: Numb or white skin in the cold needs attention from an adult.

quests.instruction: Yuki's sleeves are soaked after falling into slush. What is the best next step?
quests.correctAnswer: Go inside and change into dry clothes 🏠
options: Keep playing 🏃
Add a thin T-shirt over them 👕
Go inside and change into dry clothes 🏠
quests.explanation: Wet clothes make you cold quickly in freezing weather. Switching to dry ones is best.
quests.funFact: Carrying a spare set of clothes helps on snowy days.

quests.instruction: It is drizzling and cool, and Mia will cycle to school. Which choice makes the most sense?
quests.correctAnswer: Waterproof jacket and pants, helmet, and bright colors 🚲
options: Cotton hoodie, canvas shoes, and no helmet 👕
Waterproof jacket and pants, helmet, and bright colors 🚲
Sundress, sandals, and a sun hat 🩴
quests.hint: Think about rain, cool air, and safety.
quests.explanation: Waterproof layers keep her dry, the helmet protects her head, and bright colors help drivers see her.
quests.funFact: Bike clothing should stay clear of the chain.

quests.instruction: The sky is cloudy, the temperature is 12°C, and there's a light breeze. Priya will walk fifteen minutes to a friend's house. What is a sensible choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Light jacket over a long-sleeved shirt 🧥
options: Thick parka with snow pants ❄️
T-shirt and shorts with sandals 🩳
Light jacket over a long-sleeved shirt 🧥
quests.explanation: A light jacket over a long-sleeved shirt handles cool air without being too warm.
quests.funFact: About 12°C feels cool to most people.

quests.instruction: Which information helps you choose clothes best?
quests.correctAnswer: Temperature, wet or dry, wind, and your activity 🧠
options: Temperature, wet or dry, wind, and your activity 🧠
What your friends happen to be wearing 👕
Only the color of the sky and clouds ☁️
quests.explanation: Weather and activity tell you which clothes will protect and keep you comfortable.
quests.funFact: Weather forecasts can show temperature, rain, and wind.
